title: COPY callback: ECC key devCtx not guarded — aliased fd causes double-close
description: RESEARCH (qsi.11): wc_ecc_copy does NOT exist in wolfSSL. Only wc_ecc_copy_point() exists which copies ECC coordinates (mp_int x/y/z), not the ecc_key struct itself. There is no wolfSSL code path that XMEMCPY's a full ecc_key, so the aliased-fd scenario cannot be triggered by any wolfSSL internal function. Risk is limited to application code that manually XMEMCPY's an ecc_key struct, which would be a coding error on the application side. Downgraded P1→P3. Document as informational: wc_ecc_copy does not exist; if added to wolfSSL in the future it should dispatch through CryptoCb COPY (WC_ALGO_TYPE_PK) and the port COPY handler should guard it.
